Class TypeBEnginePassRunner

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.TypeBEnginePassRunner
public final class TypeBEnginePassRunner extends Object
Encapsulates JIT compilation, global state reset, and per-tick execution of pluggable Tier 2 cliodynamic, macroeconomic, and historical scenario engines for SimulationPipeline.

Delegates engine execution dynamically to SimulationEngineRegistry, completely eliminating hardcoded engine execution chains and manual reset lists.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • executeActiveEngines

      public void executeActiveEngines(EngineTier tier, WorldBuffer worldBuffer, double dtYears, double dtMonthly, Scenario scenario)
      Unified execution pipeline for all simulation engines of a given EngineTier. Both Tier 1 biophysical engines and Tier 2 cliodynamic engines share this exact same Single-Pass Cellular Kernel Fusion + whole-buffer stencil execution path, differing only in their EngineTier metadata and default enablement policy.
      Parameters:
      tier - engine tier to execute
      worldBuffer - contiguous world memory buffer
      dtYears - time step in Julian years
      dtMonthly - monthly-scaled year fraction
      scenario - active scenario configuration (may be null)
